warnings: Categories can overlap; adding their counts does not give a unique missing-word total.
Counts describe this supplied reference universe, not an exact Pleco comparison or proof of complete vocabulary coverage.
Canonical-key absence can still be a script-alias or reading-resolution issue. Inventory.jobs has additional alias, source-quality and frequency gates.
Reading and sense leads are unverified; they do not prove a missing pronunciation or English meaning.
No source definitions, ND snippets, secrets or model prompts are exported. No paid generation is authorised by these queues.

unresolved_english_reading.label: English canonical head absent, with unresolved permitted definition evidence
unresolved_english_reading.description: At least one permitted non-AI full-definition source row has a missing, ambiguous or invalid reading, and the canonical head has no baseline English definition. Other source rows for the head can already have readings.
unresolved_english_reading.warning: Resolve source readings and aliases before treating these as publishable missing words. Invalid readings are held alongside missing/ambiguous readings.

additional_reading_lead.label: Existing English head with an unmatched foreign-source reading lead
additional_reading_lead.description: The English head already exists. A permitted non-AI foreign-language definition has an indexed reading not represented by the English head at the exact same normalized reading.
additional_reading_lead.warning: UNVERIFIED reading lead, not a proven missing pronunciation or meaning. Sandhi, regional conventions, source errors and notation differences can explain the difference.

machine_only_english.label: Existing English coverage supplied only by machine-translated packs
machine_only_english.description: The English canonical head exists in baseline packs, and none of those English definitions is from a non-machine-translated pack.
machine_only_english.warning: Quality-upgrade queue, not a missing-word queue. Existing AI definitions prevent duplicate automatic paid generation.

available_optional_english.label: English coverage already available outside the default two packs
available_optional_english.description: The English canonical head exists in baseline packs but not in CC-CEDICT or the phrase supplement. Availability is independent of a particular user enabling/downloading the pack.
available_optional_english.warning: No new paid definition is needed merely to expose an existing optional pack. Some optional coverage is machine-translated; inspect source quality.

supplemental_new_head.label: Raw/HSK supplemental canonical heads absent from all baseline languages
supplemental_new_head.description: A permitted raw original or HSK supplement supplies a canonical head that does not appear in any baseline dictionary, across all definition languages.
supplemental_new_head.warning: Source-backed discovery lead, not automatically an accepted new word. Source errors, script aliases, missing readings and nonlexical expressions still need review.

additional_sense_lead.label: Existing English heads with unmatched explicit foreign sense anchors
additional_sense_lead.description: Only explicit source sense IDs/synset anchors are considered. An unmatched foreign anchor identifies something to compare, not a demonstrated missing English sense.
additional_sense_lead.warning: Absence of an English sense-ID mapping DOES NOT prove a missing English meaning. Most sources do not align their sense IDs. Component-review sources are discovery metadata only.
